name: YNX Pay
title: YNX Pay — Verifiable Testnet payments
metaDescription: Review Wallet-bound YNX Testnet invoices and verify payment receipts against authoritative chain evidence.
risks: Testnet assets have no claim to real-world value
A submitted transaction is not paid until authoritative finality and invoice matching complete
External routes and sponsorship may be unavailable

faq.question: When is an invoice paid?
faq.answer: Only after the chain transaction, finality, payer, payee, asset, amount and invoice intent match authoritative records.

faq.question: Are Testnet assets money?
faq.answer: No. YNXT and any labeled Testnet asset are for testing and have no claim to fiat value.

faq.question: Can YNX Pay access Wallet keys?
faq.answer: No. The Wallet retains keys and presents the final approval.

structuredDataSuggestion: SoftwareApplication with WebApplication and MobileApplication offers only after public URLs and artifacts are verified
